==Norwegian Bokmål==
{{wikipedia|no:Akt,no:Akt (drama),no:Akt (enhet),no:Akt (andre betydninger)}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|nb|/akt/|[akt]|q1=Etymologies 1–6}}
* {{audio|nb|Nb-akt.ogg|Audio}}
* {{rhymes|nb|akt|s=1|q1=Etymologies 1–6}}
* {{hyphenation|nb|akt}}

===Etymology 1===
{{ety|nb|id=ceremony|:bor|la:āctus<id:action>|tree=1}}
{{bor+|nb|la|āctus|id=action|t=act, action; performance}}, a substantivized perfect passive participle of {{m|la|agō|t=to drive; do, act}}, from {{der|nb|itc-pro|*agō|t=to drive; do, act}}, ultimately from {{m|ine-pro|*h₂eǵ-|id=drive|t=to drive}}.

Compare the parallel borrowings {{cog|da|akt|t=act, ceremony; theatre act}}, {{cog|sv|akt|t=act, ceremony; theatre act}} and {{cog|de|Akt|id=act|t=act; theatre act}}.

====Noun====
{{nb-noun|f|akta|akter|aktene|g2=m|ds2=akten}}

# a solemn or formal [[act]]; a [[ceremony]]
#: {{syn|nb|seremoni}}
#* {{quote-journal|nb|date=21 May 2001|journal=Aftenposten|page=22|passage=den høytidelige akten [på Akershus festning 1945] beseglet den ufravikelige seieren over naziveldet|translation=the solemn ceremony [at Akershus Fortress in 1945] sealed the definitive victory over Nazi rule}}
# {{lb|nb|obsolete}} an [[action]], [[activity]] or [[task]]
#* {{quote-book|nb|year=1858|author={{w|Nicolai Ramm Østgaard}}|title=Fra Skov og Fjeld|page=125|passage=budeien sad … ifærd med at melke. Jeg maatte … vente med at staa op, indtil den akt var forbi|translation=the dairymaid sat … milking. I had to … wait to get up until that task was over}}
# an act of [[sexual intercourse]]; [[sex]]
#: {{syn|nb|samleie}}
#* {{quote-book|nb|year=2001|author={{w|Helene Uri}}|title=Dyp rød|page=315|passage=han hadde en lei tendens til å rope ut obskøne ord og vendinger under akten|translation=he had an unfortunate tendency to shout obscene words and phrases during intercourse}}
#* {{quote-book|nb|year=2014|author=Lotta Elstad|title=Et eget rom|page=71|passage=hun hadde en elsker som alltid måtte ut av senga straks etter akten for å spille piano|translation=she had a lover who always had to get out of bed immediately after intercourse to play the piano}}
# {{lb|nb|drama|theater}} an [[act]], one of the major divisions of a [[play]] or other dramatic work
#* {{quote-book|nb|year=1896|author={{w|Henrik Ibsen}}|title=John Gabriel Borkman|page=93|passage=så tænkte jeg, det kanske kunde adsprede dig at høre en akt eller to|translation=then I thought it might distract you to hear an act or two}}
#* {{quote-book|nb|year=1951|author={{w|Agnar Mykle}}|title=Morgen i appelsingult|page=5|passage=hvis dette stykke hadde vært skrevet for den profesjonelle scene, ville det kanskje ha fremstått som en enhet i tid og sted, uten oppdeling i akter|translation=if this play had been written for the professional stage, it might have formed a unity of time and place, without division into acts}}
## {{lb|nb|figuratively}} a [[stage]], [[episode]] or instalment in a prolonged sequence of events
##* {{quote-journal|nb|date=16 March 2010|journal=Sarpsborg Arbeiderblad|passage=veilys på riks- og fylkesveier i Sarpsborg har vært gjennom en særdeles omstendelig politisk behandling i mange akter|translation=road lighting on national and county roads in Sarpsborg has undergone an exceptionally protracted political process in many acts}}
##* {{quote-book|nb|year=2021|author=Erlend O. Nødtvedt|title=Mordet på Henrik Ibsen|page=34|passage=stykket … utspilte seg akt for akt i Konstantinopel, Athen, Efesos, Lutetia og Vienna i Gallia|translation=the play … unfolded act by act in Constantinople, Athens, Ephesus, Lutetia and Vienna in Gaul}}

===Etymology 2===
[[Image:Corinth weibl Halbakt.jpg|upright=1.13|thumb|Pencil drawing of woman, posing as a nude model.]]
{{ety|nb|id=nude|:bor|de:Akt<id:act>|tree=1}}
{{bor+|nb|de|Akt|id=act|t=nude model; artistic representation of a nude person}}. The German word is ultimately from {{m|la|āctus|id=action|t=act, action; performance}}, from the same Latin verb as in Etymology 1.

====Noun====
{{nb-noun|f|akta|akter|aktene|g2=m|ds2=akten}}

# {{lb|nb|art}} a [[nude]] [[model]]; an artist's model posing nude
#: '''stå akt''', '''sitte akt''' — to pose nude as an artist's model
#: '''tegne akt''' — to draw a nude model
#: '''male akt''' — to paint a nude model
#* {{quote-journal|nb|date=24 November 2004|journal=Ranablad|passage=Rana kunstforening har ingen lokale modeller som vil sitte akt for dem|translation=Rana Art Association has no local models willing to pose nude for them}}
#* {{quote-journal|nb|date=18 January 2014|journal=Trønder-Avisa|page=21|passage=å tegne og male akt er noe av det viktigste i kunstundervisningen|translation=drawing and painting nude models is one of the most important elements of art education}}
# {{lb|nb|art}} a [[nude]], an artwork depicting a naked person
#* {{quote-journal|nb|date=27 June 1942|journal=Sandefjords Blad|page=4|passage=en større akt av Munch gikk for 6200 kr.|translation=a larger nude by Munch sold for 6,200 kroner}}

* {{l|nb|aktmaling|t=nude painting}}
* {{l|nb|aktmodell|t=nude model}}
* {{l|nb|aktstudie|t=nude study}}
* {{l|nb|aktstudium|t=nude study}}
* {{l|nb|akttegning|t=nude drawing}}
{{bottom}}

===Etymology 3===
{{ety|nb|:bor|la:ācta<id:acts>|tree=1}}
{{bor+|nb|la|ācta|id=acts|t=things done; official records}}, the substantivized neuter plural of the perfect passive participle of {{m|la|agō|t=to drive; do, act}}.

Compare the parallel borrowings {{cog|da|akt|t=official document, case file}} and {{cog|de|Akte|t=file, dossier}}.

====Noun====
{{nb-noun-m1}}

# {{lb|nb|law|especially in the plural}} a [[record]], [[document]], [[case file]] or formal [[act]]; especially a written record of legal proceedings or an official case document
#* {{quote-web|nb|date=18 April 2011|work=Dagbladet|passage=via hjelpere i politiet … begynner han å undersøke alle sakens akter om igjen og finner spor ingen har tenkt på før|translation=through helpers in the police … he begins examining all the case records again and finds clues no one has previously considered}}

=====Derived terms=====
* {{l|nb|aktstykke|t=official document}}
* {{l|nb|parlamentsakt|t=act of parliament}}

===Etymology 4===
{{bor+|nb|gml|ācht|t=outlawry, proscription}}; compare the Middle Low German variant {{m|gml|āchte|t=outlawry, proscription}}. The legal sense developed from an older Germanic meaning “hostile pursuit, persecution”.

Compare {{cog|gmh|āhte|t=pursuit, proscription, outlawry}}, {{cog|goh|āhta|t=hostile pursuit}}, {{cog|ang|ōht|t=persecution, hostility}} and {{cog|de|Acht|t=outlawry, ban}}. The further origin is uncertain.

====Noun====
{{head|nb|noun|g=m|definite singular|akten}}

# {{lb|nb|historical|chiefly of older German conditions}} [[outlawry]], [[proscription]]; the condition of having been deprived of legal protection
#: {{syn|nb|fredløshet}}
#: '''erklære i rikets akt''' — to place someone under the [[imperial]] [[ban]]; to declare someone an [[outlaw]]

===Etymology 5===
{{bor+|nb|gml|acht|t=attention, consideration; opinion, esteem; intention}}, related to {{m|gml|achten|t=to consider, heed, esteem}}. The Norwegian senses reflect the older semantic range “thought or consideration; opinion or esteem; intention”.

Compare {{cog|gmh|ahte|t=consideration, opinion, esteem}}, {{cog|goh|ahta|t=consideration, opinion, esteem}}, {{cog|ang|eahtian|t=to deliberate, evaluate}}, {{cog|nl|achten|t=to regard, esteem}} and {{cog|de|achten|t=to heed, esteem}}. Old Norse {{m|non|ætla|t=to intend, suppose}} has traditionally been connected with the same Germanic family.

====Noun====
{{nb-noun-m1}}

# {{lb|nb|obsolete}} [[attention]], [[heed]] or [[notice]], now chiefly surviving in fixed expressions
#: {{syn|nb|oppmerksomhet}}
#: '''gi akt (på)''' — to [[heed]], pay attention (to) or take account (of)
#* {{quote-book|nb|year=1873|author={{w|Henrik Ibsen}}|title=Kejser og Galilæer|page=453|passage=giv nøje agt på denne fremmede|translation=pay close attention to this stranger}}
#* {{quote-book|nb|year=1920|author={{w|Sigrid Undset}}|title=Kransen|page=49|passage=ingen gav akt paa Kristin|translation=no one paid attention to Kristin}}
#* {{quote-book|nb|year=2000|author=Kari Bøge|title=For alt jeg vet|passage=jeg må behandle alt som blir sagt varsomt, jeg må gi akt på hvert ord som faller|translation=I must treat everything that is said carefully; I must pay attention to every word spoken}}
#: {{lb|nb|military}} '''giv akt!''' — [[attention]]!; a command to come to attention
#: '''ta i akt''' — to take into account, consider or allow for
#* {{quote-book|nb|year=1873|author={{w|Henrik Ibsen}}|title=Kejser og Galilæer|page=416|passage=det er dette, som du ikke har taget i act|translation=this is what you have failed to take into account}}
#* {{quote-journal|nb|date=15 December 2005|journal=Tidsskrift for Den norske lægeforening|page=125|passage=[i] beskrivelsen av Becks kognitive terapi [har ikke] forfatteren … tatt i akt Wittgensteins poeng om at ords mening er deres bruk i språket|translation=in the description of Beck's cognitive therapy, the author has not … taken account of Wittgenstein's point that the meaning of words is their use in language}}
#: {{lb|nb|archaic}} '''ta tiden i akt''' — to make good use of one's time
#* {{quote-book|nb|year=1920|author={{w|Sigrid Undset}}|title=Kransen|page=125|passage=en skal ta tiden vel iagt, for her har hver time sit bruk og sin sysselsættelse|translation=one must make good use of time, for here every hour has its use and its task}}
#: '''ta seg i akt''' — to take care, be cautious or [[beware]]
#* {{quote-book|nb|year=2010|author={{w|Lars Saabye Christensen}}|title=Bernhard Hvals forsnakkelser|passage=hvis de ikke tok seg i akt ville Franck i Bogstadveien miste en villig kunde og arbeidsplasser|translation=unless they took care, Franck in Bogstadveien would lose a willing customer and jobs}}
# {{lb|nb|obsolete}} [[opinion]], [[reputation]], [[esteem]], [[reverence]] or [[respect]], now chiefly surviving in fixed expressions
#: {{syn|nb|anseelse|aktelse|respekt}}
#: '''være i akt og ære''' — to be highly esteemed or regarded
#* {{quote-book|nb|year=1870|author={{w|Peter Christen Asbjørnsen}}|title=Norske Huldre-Eventyr og Folkesagn|page=113|passage=det var en gaardmandskone [som hodeskallen hadde sittet på], og hun bar baade i agt og ære|translation=it was a farmer's wife [on whom the skull had sat], and she was held in both esteem and honour}}
#: '''stå (høyt) i akt''' — to be held in high esteem
#: '''holde i akt (og ære)''' — to esteem, value or hold in high regard
#* {{quote-book|nb|year=1992|author=Odd Selmer|title=Og verden var som ny|passage=fordi han kjente bordets historie, men også fordi han hadde sans for godt håndverk, holdt August Arntzen bordet høyt i akt og ære|translation=because he knew the table's history and appreciated good craftsmanship, August Arntzen held the table in high esteem}}
#* {{quote-book|nb|year=1917|author={{w|Knut Hamsun}}|title=Markens Grøde|volume=II|page=9|passage=du vil vise mig den agt og ære at du vil møte paa auktionen min?|translation=will you show me the respect and honour of attending my auction?}}
# {{lb|nb|obsolete|archaic}} [[intention]], [[purpose]] or [[design]]
#: {{syn|nb|hensikt}}
#* {{quote-book|nb|year=1884|author={{w|Alexander Kielland}}|title=Fortuna|page=50|passage=det var hans agt at gifte sig strax|translation=it was his intention to marry immediately}}
#* {{quote-book|nb|year=1903|author={{w|Otto Sverdrup}}|title=Nyt Land|volume=II|page=427|passage=det var vor agt at nedlægge et lidet depot|translation=it was our intention to establish a small depot}}
#* {{quote-book|nb|year=1909|author={{w|Sigrid Undset}}|title=Fortællingen om Viga-Ljot og Vigdis|page=14|passage=far til dine frænder … som din agt var|translation=go to your kinsmen … as you intended}}
#* {{quote-book|nb|year=1920|author={{w|Sigrid Undset}}|title=Kransen|page=115|passage=det er nu ikke min agt at vi skal sætte os ned på Formo straks|translation=it is not my intention that we should settle at Formo immediately}}
